# catalyst_nosql_table (Data Source)

Read an existing NoSQL table's identity, status, primary keys, additional sort keys, TTL settings and index identities/statuses. schema_json contains the allowlisted public metadata fields, excluding items, metrics and creator profiles. Requires NoSQL table READ access. This data source does not create tables, indexes or TTL configuration. Denied access, null, incomplete or mismatched responses return an error. Live validation is limited to India Development.

## Example Usage

```terraform
variable "project_id" { type = string }
variable "table_id" { type = string }

data "catalyst_nosql_table" "site" {
  project_id = var.project_id
  id         = var.table_id
}

output "schema" { value = jsondecode(data.catalyst_nosql_table.site.schema_json) }
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Existing table ID, written as a string.
- `project_id` (String) Existing project ID, written as a string.

### Read-Only

- `name` (String) Verified table name reported by Catalyst.
- `schema_json` (String) Allowlisted table metadata as JSON. Use jsondecode to read its fields. Does not contain application data or default values.
